capabilities: Expands [] or 【】 plus Space into a - [ ] checkbox
Reverts a checkbox to plain text with Backspace
Syncs Markdown notes through a private GitHub repository
Signs in with GitHub OAuth device flow
Keeps both copies when devices edit the same note
extras: Sync token stays in memory for the session; snapshots capped at 950,000 UTF-8 bytes; default scope is three Chinese-named legacy folders unless whole-vault sync is enabled; auto-sync every five minutes while Obsidian is in the foreground.
problem: Obsidian gives no keystroke that turns a plain line into a task checkbox, and its built-in sync is not a bring-your-own-private-repository option.

relations.evidence: sync Markdown notes between devices through a private GitHub repository that you own

summary: Expander that turns [] or 【】 plus Space into a Markdown task checkbox, with optional note sync through your own private GitHub repository.
